Name: Sheet Pan Chicken and Vegetables
Description: Easy one-pan meal prep that yields 4-5 servings. Perfect for hitting your macros throughout the week.
content:
Ingredients

Protein

  • 2 lbs chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1 teaspoon paprika
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Vegetables

  • 2 cups broccoli florets
  • 2 cups sweet potato, cubed
  • 1 red bell pepper, chopped
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C)
  2. In a large bowl, toss chicken with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper
  3. In another bowl, toss vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper
  4. Arrange chicken and vegetables on a large sheet pan, keeping them separate
  5. Bake for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through (internal temp 165°F) and vegetables are tender
  6. Let cool slightly, then divide into 5 meal prep containers
  7. Store in refrigerator for up to 5 days

Nutrition (per serving)

  • Calories: 385
  • Protein: 42g
  • Carbs: 24g
  • Fat: 12g

Meal Prep Tips

  • Use parchment paper or silicone mat for easy cleanup
  • Keep chicken and vegetables separate so they cook evenly
  • Add rice or quinoa to containers for extra carbs if needed
  • Reheat in microwave for 2-3 minutes when ready to eat

Variations

  • Swap chicken for turkey or lean beef
  • Try different veggie combos: zucchini, Brussels sprouts, carrots
  • Season with different spice blends: Italian, Cajun, or Mexican
